 In-hand images of the Travis Scott x CPFM x Nike Air Flea 1 show an earthy, oversized sneaker with green laces and pink details. div>p>iframe]:w-full [&>div>p>iframe]:aspect-video
 [&>div>p>iframe]:!h-auto [&>div>p>iframe]:!mx-auto [&>div>p>iframe]:min-w-[auto] [&>div>p>iframe]:lg:min-w-[382px] min-h-[200px] [&_ol]:list-decimal [&_ol]:list-outside [&_ol]:pl-[30px] [&_h3]:font-bold [&_h3]:text-xl [&_h3]:mb-8"> Travis Scott and Cactus Plant Flea Market are teaming up with Nike on one of the strangest sneakers in the lineup. The Travis Scott x CPFM x Nike Air Flea 1 is set to release in Spring 2027 for $180.
 The first in-hand images have arrived, and the pair is as unusual as expected. It first surfaced as a three-way sneaker that mashes up Travis’ Field Jaxx with the Flea 1 , and it keeps the chunky, oversized shape fans know from CPFM.
 The colors are earthy. Khaki and tan cover the upper, and a chunky brown midsole gives the shoe a rugged look. Travis’ reverse Swoosh sits on the sides, and thick green laces keep the theme going.
 Pink adds a surprise. It shows up on the tongue, the insoles, and the inner side of the shoe, opposite the Cactus Jack x CPFM branding. A black tongue helps the pink FLEA logo pop.
 The style code is IX7250-200. Pairs are expected in unisex sizing through CPFM, Travis Scott’s website, Nike, and select retailers.
 The Flea 1 has a long history. CPFM first revealed it in 2022, but sizing problems delayed the release for years. The standard Flea 1 is expected to finally reach retail this holiday season, with Travis’ version following in the spring.
 Read More: Kirk Franklin Recalls Kanye West's Unusual Offer To Produce Gospel Music 
 Travis Scott x CPFM x Nike Air Flea 1
 Travis and CPFM have a long history. Their Air Force 1 Low collaborations have appeared in several special pairs, including horse hair and fur designs.
 This time, a wider release makes the project more exciting. Fans have waited for years to see CPFM’s Flea 1 reach stores, and Travis’ version is a big upgrade.
 Travis also keeps his Nike calendar busy. The Travis Scott “Pink Pack” Jordan 1 Lows and the reported Jordan 1 Low “Chicago” show how much demand he drives.
 Sneakers from Travis tend to sell out quickly, and an unusual shape like the Flea 1 could bring in a different type of buyer. That could make this one a surprise hit.
 Overall, this is a creative three-way collab that fits Travis’ style perfectly. It is bold, earthy, and a little weird, which is exactly what fans want.
